description: 项目履约主题域，覆盖项目、客户、合同、摆位和实摆绿植。Sprint-25 默认使用 PostgreSQL dbt mart，不再使用 legacy v_project_* 视图。

objects.name: 项目总览
objects.description: 项目点主数据、客户、合同、摆位和当前实摆汇总的项目级 ADS，适合回答项目经营 TOP、项目清单、项目状态和实摆规模；adminweb 对账字段对齐 ProjectSummary listPage 当前运营口径。

objects.name: 项目实摆月度
objects.description: 项目 x 月粒度的实摆行数、数量、租金和成本汇总；同时保留 raw 合计和 adminweb ProjectSummary 对账口径。

objects.name: 项目实摆明细
objects.description: 实摆绿植明细事实，包含项目、摆位、物品、状态、数量、租金、成本、adminweb 对账字段和软外键质量标记。

objects.name: 摆位调整
objects.description: 摆位调整主表和明细打宽后的 DWD，适合回答调整状态、调整数量、调整类型和异常摆位。

objects.name: 合同到期预警
objects.description: 合同状态、结束日期和到期预警 ADS，适合回答 30/60/90 天内到期合同。

objects.name: 项目状态分布
objects.description: 项目状态和实摆状态的统一分布 ADS。

fewShots.question: 项目经营 TOP 怎么样？
fewShots.sql: SELECT project_name AS 项目, customer_name AS 客户, green_row_count AS 实摆行数, real_good_number_adminweb_sum AS 实摆数量, ROUND(rent_amount_adminweb_sum::numeric, 2) AS 月租金 FROM public.xycyl_ads_project_overview ORDER BY green_row_count DESC LIMIT 10

fewShots.question: XX 项目当前有多少实摆绿植？
fewShots.sql: SELECT project_name AS 项目, green_row_count AS 实摆行数, real_good_number_adminweb_sum AS 实摆数量, position_count AS 摆位数 FROM public.xycyl_ads_project_overview WHERE project_name ILIKE '%' || :project_name || '%'

fewShots.question: 哪些合同 90 天内到期？
fewShots.sql: SELECT contract_code AS 合同编码, contract_title AS 合同名称, customer_name AS 客户, end_date AS 到期日, days_to_end_date AS 剩余天数 FROM public.xycyl_ads_contract_expiry_alert WHERE days_to_end_date BETWEEN 0 AND :days ORDER BY days_to_end_date ASC

fewShots.question: 项目状态和实摆状态分布
fewShots.sql: SELECT status_subject AS 对象, status_label AS 状态, row_count AS 数量 FROM public.xycyl_ads_project_status_dist ORDER BY status_subject, row_count DESC

fewShots.question: XX 项目最近月度实摆趋势
fewShots.sql: SELECT stat_month AS 月份, green_row_count AS 实摆行数, real_good_number_adminweb_sum AS 实摆数量, ROUND(rent_amount_adminweb_sum::numeric, 2) AS 月租金 FROM public.xycyl_dws_project_green_monthly WHERE project_name ILIKE '%' || :project_name || '%' ORDER BY stat_month DESC LIMIT 12

fewShots.question: 摆位调整完成情况
fewShots.sql: SELECT adjustment_status_label AS 状态, COUNT(*) AS 明细数, SUM(adjustment_number) AS 调整数量 FROM public.xycyl_dwd_position_adjustment GROUP BY adjustment_status_label ORDER BY 明细数 DESC
